conclusions.scope: PDF p2 Figures1–2, §III pp2–4 Eqs1–6, Supp p8 opening
conclusions.finding: Concatenated final hidden feature maps feed depthwise spatial then pointwise cross-channel convolutions, with BN/ReLU on both layers. Same-architecture case shares low layers and has private high branches; heterogeneous architectures train independently. Mean member logits teach the fused head; fused head teaches the members; each has CE and all train simultaneously.
conclusions.relationship: Direct prior for nonlinear hidden-state fusion beyond weighted logits. A frozen graph-conditioned residual MLP is an adaptation, without FFL online KD or a verified graph recipe.

conclusions.scope: Revisited text lines313–435; prior complete method pp3–5
conclusions.finding: Peer features are concatenated and classified by an additional fully connected layer, trained with teacher CE and KD plus peer/EMA collaboration.
conclusions.relationship: Direct prior for learned hidden-feature fusion; additional nonlinear/head or graph context utility is unresolved for this cached four-route setting.

conclusions.finding: Cross-stitch and sluice mix continuing task representations linearly; sluice adds within-task shared/private feature subspaces.
conclusions.relationship: Supports cross-stream communication ancestry. Late frozen concat readout is a different placement; neither orthogonality nor centered hidden states certifies member-error independence.

conclusions.finding: ONE learns a gated logit ensemble teacher for shared/private branches; Collaborative Learning coordinates hard/soft heads with shared-backprop scaling.
conclusions.relationship: Shared-branch aggregation/training ancestry, not evidence that a frozen hidden readout is useless or useful.

conclusions.finding: C&S propagates supervised TRAIN residuals, rescales and smooths predictions. Official pinned code uses Y-probability followed by addition; printed v2 still uses Z-Y followed by addition.
conclusions.derived_identity: With the same TRAIN mask, common linear operator T and common scale s, mean_m[P_m+s*T(M_train*(Y-P_m))]=P_bar+s*T(M_train*(Y-P_bar)). Centered residual contrasts cancel in the mean.
conclusions.scope_limit: Native autoscale, clipping and member-specific choices can break linear commutation; no equality for full native C&S is asserted.
conclusions.relationship: Published graph-correlated error correction is a baseline/ingredient. The proposed labels-free context does not estimate TRAIN residuals or inherit C&S results.

conclusions.finding: Structure-conditioned score gating and supervised nonlinear stacking of fixed graph scores are prior. Link-MoE collab gate consumes 80% official VALID labels and selects on20%.
conclusions.relationship: Use a same-context nonlinear score stacker and disclose/match extra supervision. No node C&S-to-link port is assumed.

conclusions.NC: For scalar simplex weights applied to the whole member logit vector at a node, a common competitor c with z_m,c>z_m,y for every m still outranks y after pooling. All members wrong with different competitors does not imply this ceiling.
conclusions.LP: With candidate-specific simplex weights, common per-member pair ordering is insufficient; a strict range separation max_m s_m(positive)<min_m s_m(negative) prevents reversal, whereas overlapping ranges may allow it.
conclusions.relationship: A learned non-convex-hull readout can overcome these score-only restrictions only when supplied information/training supports it; no success claim.

conclusions.finding: Does a frozen nonlinear head on all four private hidden states plus fixed labels-free graph context improve heldout served NLL/accuracy beyond a capacity-matched nonlinear score-context head, linear feature readout and strongest single feature head?
conclusions.information_scope: For population log loss, unrestricted improvement from adding per-node private hidden bank H to scores/context Q is I(Y;H|Q). This is a conditional-information criterion, not an estimated quantity here or a generalization guarantee.
conclusions.disposition: Retain one unadopted utility shortlist item. No novelty/superiority claim, no current execution or gate change.
